heading: Migrating old names
body: Run ty migrate fix --write after reviewing your changes. Controller becomes RequestRoute. Client, WebCall and the Exchange names are retired. Use HTTPClient and the Request method annotations. RequestMapping and RestController become RequestRoute. CookieValue becomes FromCookie, and RequestPart becomes FromBody. Resource is retired: write Needs on a field whose name says which object it receives (ADR 0038). Behaviors is a name that Tachyon generates for its own code, not an annotation, so @Behaviors stops the build. Each old name stops the build with TY1308, and the message names the new one. GetMapping becomes GetRoute; the other verb mappings change the same way. GetRoute with Stream becomes StreamRoute, and a get method name starts with stream. Move Yon controllers into server/controllers/. Remove yon.* route markers and OPTIONS.schema.json after migrating their behavior. YonRequest and YonResponse are removed: ty migrate fix --write removes an unused YonRequest parameter and lists the rest, with the native request and response of each language (ADR 0062).
